contract.case: compile(pattern) must succeed; every label in `match` must match; every label in `noMatch` must not
contract.error: compile(pattern) must REFUSE with a message, and the refused matcher must then match every label: a pattern nobody could read hides nothing
contract.junk: compile(pattern) and one match call must not crash, whatever was typed

errors.note: One rule refuses every spelling in this table that involves a backtick: it is an anchor, so it belongs at the very start or the very end. Before sets moved to […] each needed its own ruling.

[\n]: a regex habit that would silently mean the letter n
errors.note: Ruled 2026-09-23: unicode and emoji must be escapable, and only \\ \] \- were. The rule that grants both: a backslash may escape anything EXCEPT an ASCII letter or digit. Punctuation, symbols and every non-ASCII character are literals either way, so escaping them is harmless; a letter after a backslash is a regex class to the reader and the letter itself here, which is the silent misread this language refuses.

[\b]: the same, for a word boundary

`a|b` -- anchors do not wrap alternatives
errors.note: The trap groups exist to replace: it parsed cleanly as "starts with a" OR "ends with b".

an unclosed group
groups do not nest -- the middle || closes, the last one is left open
three bars in a row are never a guess
errors.note: This one rule is what keeps || decidable, and it is also what makes an empty group and an empty branch unwritable.
